eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: metropolitan planning organizations; political subdivisions of a State or territory; federally recognized Tribal governments; multijurisdictional groups of these entities (with a lead applicant)
eligibility.quote: 1. a metropolitan planning organization (MPO); 2. a political subdivision of a State or territory; 3. a federally recognized Tribal government; and 4. a multijurisdictional group of entities made up of any of the aforementioned three types of entities.

eligibility.item: Non-profits are not eligible unless created under State law with roadway safety and/or planning responsibilities equivalent to a political subdivision; States and territories are not eligible and cannot be co-applicants
eligibility.quote: Non-profits are not eligible applicants unless created under State law with roadway safety and/or planning responsibilities equivalent to a political subdivision of a State. States and territories are not eligible applicants.

eligibility.item: Implementation Grant applicants must have roadway ownership/maintenance responsibilities, safety responsibilities affecting roadways, or a signed agreement with the roadway owner
eligibility.quote: An eligible applicant for an Implementation Grant must also meet at least one of the following conditions: have ownership and/or maintenance responsibilities over a roadway network; have safety responsibilities that affect roadways; or

eligibility.item: One application only per applicant; if eligible for both, choose Planning and Demonstration or Implementation; the last application submitted is reviewed
eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants may submit one application only to the FY 2026 funding opportunity. If multiple applications are received from the same political subdivision of a State and/or applicant, the last application submitted will be reviewed.

eligibility.item: Implementation Grant applicants must certify an existing plan substantially similar to an Action Plan, finalized and/or last updated between 2021 and May 26, 2026 (up to three plans combined, or a covering jurisdiction's plan)
eligibility.quote: the applicant must certify that they have an existing plan that is substantially similar to an Action Plan as defined in Section B and Table 1: Action Plan Components and has been finalized and/or last updated between 2021 and May 26, 2026.

eligibility.item: Applicants without an existing Action Plan must apply for a Planning and Demonstration Grant, not an Implementation Grant
eligibility.quote: If an applicant does not have an existing Action Plan or is not located in a jurisdiction which has an existing Action Plan, they should apply for a Planning and Demonstration Grant to develop one. They should NOT apply for an Implementation Grant.

eligibility.item: State-level plans (SHSP, State Highway Safety Plans, Commercial Vehicle Safety Plans, PTASPs) cannot qualify for an Implementation Grant
eligibility.quote: State-level Action Plans (e.g., a Strategic Highway Safety Plan required under 23 U.S.C. § 148, State Highway Safety Plans required under 23 U.S.C. § 402, Commercial Vehicle Safety Plans

eligibility.item: Implementation Grant applicants with a "no" on the Self-Certification Worksheet or a plan not covering all road users must update their Action Plan during the period of performance
eligibility.quote: Implementation Grant applicants who meet any of the following conditions must update their Action Plan during the period of performance for the grant agreement to align with all Action Plan components

eligibility.item: Planning and Demonstration applicants requesting only supplemental planning/demonstration must have an existing eligible Action Plan, an SS4A-funded plan in progress, or a covering higher-level jurisdiction's plan (with coordination)
eligibility.quote: Applicants requesting Federal funding to conduct supplemental planning and/or demonstration activities only, without developing or updating an Action Plan must either a) have an existing Action Plan

eligibility.item: A new Action Plan must cover all road users and the applicant's entire jurisdiction; corridor-level or site-specific studies are supplemental planning
eligibility.quote: The development of an Action Plan must include all relevant road users and be at a broad, systemwide geography (i.e., the eligible applicant's entire jurisdiction, not a few road segments within a jurisdiction).

eligibility.item: Requests to develop a new Action Plan duplicating another SS4A-funded or FY26-requested plan in the same area may be ineligible
eligibility.quote: An application may be deemed duplicative, and therefore ineligible, if it requests funds to develop a new Action Plan when another jurisdiction is already preparing an Action Plan in the same area using SS4A funding

eligibility.item: Applications including Action Plan development or updates must affirm coordination with geographically overlapping SS4A-funded or FY26-applying jurisdictions
eligibility.quote: the applicant agency must affirm that they will coordinate with any jurisdictions that geographically overlap with the applicant jurisdiction and have received SS4A funding to develop or update an Action Plan

eligibility.item: Implementation Grant activities must include carrying out projects and strategies identified in an Action Plan (element C)
eligibility.quote: For Implementation Grants, activities must include element (C) and may include element (B).

eligibility.item: Ineligible project activities include those whose primary purpose is not roadway safety, non-roadway modes, new motor-vehicle roadways, capacity expansion without a safety nexus, state-of-good-repair maintenance, and PTASPs
eligibility.quote: The following activities are not eligible for element (C) "projects and strategies" nor demonstration activity funding: Projects and strategies whose primary purpose is not roadway safety.

eligibility.item: Must be registered in SAM before submitting, provide an active UEI, and maintain active SAM registration
eligibility.quote: Be registered in SAM (https://sam.gov/content/home) before submitting its application; b. Provide an active unique entity identifier in its application; and

eligibility.item: Budgets must not include previously incurred expenses or costs incurred before award and obligation
eligibility.quote: This budget should not include any previously incurred expenses, or costs to be incurred before the time of award and obligation because these expenses are not eligible for reimbursement or cost-sharing.

requiredDocuments.quote: All applicants must submit the following Standard Forms: Application for Federal Assistance (SF-424),

requiredDocuments.item: Planning and Demonstration: Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424A) and Assurances for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424B)
requiredDocuments.quote: Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424A), Assurances for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424B), and Disclosure of Lobbying Activities (SF-LLL).

requiredDocuments.item: Implementation: Budget Information for Construction Programs (SF-424C) and Assurances for Construction Programs (SF-424D)
requiredDocuments.quote: Budget Information for Construction Programs (SF-424C), Assurances for Construction Programs (SF-424D), and
Assurances for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424B), and Disclosure of Lobbying Activities (SF-LLL).

requiredDocuments.item: Key Information Questions answered in Valid Eval (applicant, UEI, entity type, population, FARS fatality data, underserved communities, funding amounts)
requiredDocuments.quote: Key Information Questions The following questions are asked in the SS4A application on Valid Eval

requiredDocuments.item: Planning and Demonstration Grant Supplemental Estimated Budget (template), in whole dollars by activity and funding source
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants are required to show how different funding sources will contribute to each activity and present the data in whole dollars in a table similar to Table 3: Planning and Demonstration Grant Supplemental Estimated Budget

requiredDocuments.item: Implementation Grant Supplemental Estimated Budget (template), itemized by location/project and activity element (A), (B), (C)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants are required to submit an Implementation Grant Supplemental Estimated Budget that provides an overview of estimated activity costs, organized by all major cost elements.

requiredDocuments.item: Map in PDF and spatial format showing the jurisdiction and its roadway network (plus high-injury network and project locations for Implementation; demonstration pilot locations if known)
requiredDocuments.quote: The applicant must submit a map in both PDF and spatial format (e.g., Shapefile, .KML) that shows the location of the jurisdiction and highlights the roadway network under the applicant's jurisdiction.

requiredDocuments.item: Self-Certification Eligibility Worksheet (Implementation applicants; Planning and Demonstration applicants doing only supplemental planning/demonstration from an existing plan)
requiredDocuments.quote: Submit a completed Self-Certification Eligibility Worksheet demonstrating that the jurisdiction has an Action Plan that meets the requirements described in Table 1: Action Plan Components.

requiredDocuments.item: Existing Action Plan(s) (up to three) as attachments or public web links (Implementation applicants)
requiredDocuments.quote: The plan, or a combination of up to three plans, must be uploaded as an attachment to the application or provided as web links to publicly available sites.

requiredDocuments.item: Proof of coordination (letter, email) from all geographically overlapping SS4A entities (applications including Action Plan development or updates)
requiredDocuments.quote: Proof of coordination (e.g., letter, email) from ALL such geographically overlapping entities affirming they are aware of your application and the need for coordination to avoid duplication of efforts must be provided as an attachment to the application.

requiredDocuments.item: Signed letter, MOU or other agreement from the roadway owner/maintainer (Implementation applicants relying on an agreement)
requiredDocuments.quote: have an agreement in the form of a signed letter, MOU, or other documentation from the agency that has ownership and/or maintenance responsibilities for the roadway within the applicant's jurisdiction.

requiredDocuments.item: Detailed activity schedule of all major project and strategy milestones, including NEPA, utility relocation and right-of-way disposition (Implementation, in Project Readiness)
requiredDocuments.quote: As part of this portion of the narrative, the applicant must include a detailed activity schedule that identifies all major project and strategy milestones.

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of support (encouraged), as one consolidated attachment
requiredDocuments.quote: Letters of support are encouraged, especially from relevant stakeholders and Public Safety Agencies and associated Labor Unions representing First Responders.
